description: Prompted-controller trajectories on unused FEVER train claims, for controller imitation (behavioural cloning) and controller GRPO claim screening.

claims.sampler: agent.action_cache.train_claims(6000, seed=2): excludes every train ID in verifier/data/eval/fever-evaluation-v1/usage-audit.json (all SFT/GRPO data) and reserved calibration/holdout IDs

base_revision: a2b1c07 plus the agent/ changes committed with this data
format: agent/docs trace schema 2 (one JSON row per claim: steps with controller text/validity, final, cost, reward, gold)
license: Claims and evidence from FEVER (CC BY-SA 3.0 Wikipedia text).
